title: Listen, read and collect your own words
description: Open the meaning right in the text, keep the context and review words from the material you chose.

blocks.text: A person wants to read an article or listen to a story that interests them. Stopping for the dictionary breaks the reading, and a card on its own without the original phrase is a poor reminder of why the word was needed.

quote.text: The audio is not the flat, sort of accent-less drinking you get with other apps. It’s engaging, and challenging. Multiple people who speak differently and at different speeds is what really happens in life.

blocks.text: Collect words from the material you chose

The meaning opens next to the text. What is saved keeps the sentence and the place in the audio, if there is one. You can replay a short line, then carry on with the material and later review the words you chose in their context.
Go back to the place you didn’t understand

The first version can be limited to one kind of material. Cards created automatically need checking: the meaning depends on the sentence. If importing and reviewing take more work than ordinary notes, it is too early to widen the catalog.
